script:
The U.S. government might become a shareholder in OpenAI. Sam Altman has reportedly pitched Trump officials — including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent — on handing Washington a 5% equity stake, worth roughly $42.6 billion off OpenAI's $852 billion valuation. The model floated: something like the Alaska Permanent Fund, where corporate equity feeds a sovereign wealth fund — echoing the government's 10% stake in Intel earlier this year. Anthropic says it hasn't had those talks, but if this moves forward, Washington could end up a part-owner of the AI tools knowledge workers use every day.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
caption: OpenAI has reportedly offered Washington a $42.6 billion, 5% equity stake modeled on the government's Intel deal — here's what a government-owned slice of AI could mean for your tools. #AI #OpenAI #TechNews #FOWLAI
